verdict.rationale: Deepgram's own docs include a guide to transcribing live streaming audio in real time through its SDKs. The dg CLI also streams live audio, and the API Playground offers live streaming transcription, so the core real-time streaming capability is first-party. However, the evidence never shows the raw speech-to-text WebSocket endpoint or its protocol (the only wss URL cited is the separate voice-agent endpoint), so coverage of the 'documented WebSocket or streaming endpoint' part is incomplete. missing for 10: an explicitly documented STT WebSocket/streaming endpoint URL and message protocol, latency or interim-result details, and independent hands-on corroboration of live streaming transcription.

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream live audio over a documented WebSocket or streaming endpoint and receive transcription in real time

citations.quote: In this guide, you'll learn how to automatically transcribe live streaming audio in real time using Deepgram's SDKs
The dg CLI lets you transcribe files, stream live audio, synthesize speech, analyze text, and manage your Deepgram account from the terminal.
Deepgram API Playground — try live streaming transcription
